note: Fond du Lac County park at Calumet Harbor on the east shore of Lake Winnebago, about 10 miles NE of Fond du Lac. One open, grassy loop with scattered shade trees, set back from the harbor behind the park road, picnic lawns and the boat-launch lot. Marina with overnight boat docking, six launch lanes and a fish-cleaning station; part-time campground hosts. --Claude
summary: Konect booking site confirms 40 sites (36 back-in + 4 pull-through A-D), all 20/30/50-amp, pads 33-40+ ft, $28 + $6 res fee, 14-night summer limit, holiday 2-night minimum; 2027 calendar runs May 9-Oct 11. Waterfront lakeview -> not waterfront: no site photo shows water, harbor 110-150 m away across the park road, picnic lawn and parking, open lake behind a wooded spit.
